name: Bolivia
capital: La Paz (administrative capital); Sucre (constitutional [legislative and judicial] capital)

indicators.indicator: Political stability and absence of violence

partiesListed.party: Autonomy for Bolivia – Súmate or APB Súmate

profile.languages: Spanish (official) 68.1%, Quechua (official) 17.2%, Aymara (official) 10.5%, Guarani (official) 0.6%, other 1.5%, unspecified 2.1%; note - Spanish and all Indigenous languages are official (2012 est.)
profile.religions: Roman Catholic 65%, Protestant 19.6% (Evangelical (non-specific) 11.9%, Evangelical Baptist 2.1%, Evangelical Pentecostal 1.8%, Evangelical Methodist 0.7%, Adventist 2.8%, Protestant (non-specific) 0.3%), Believer (not belonging to the church) 0.9%, other 4.8%, atheist 1.7%, agnostic 0.6%, none 6.1%
profile.legalSystem: civil law system with influences from Roman, Spanish, canon (religious), French, and ethnic groups' pre-colonial law
profile.suffrage: 18 years of age; universal and compulsory
profile.location: Central South America, southwest of Brazil
